scope: Faro Cathedral in the July 2014 appearance, including the church, attached ranges and the separately mapped but physically connected bell tower and entry portal. The garden, separately mapped São Miguel Chapel and interiors are outside this model.

originalReview.notes: Northern square panorama shows plastered side volumes, rounded roof junctions and the position of the tower relative to the nave.
Western oblique shows the stone tower, open three-bay bell crown, pointed lower portals, pale entrance steps and attached white elevations.

quallaSearch.notes: Two exact July 2014 Qualla originals are Benoît Prieur’s own photographs under explicit CC0 dedications. The two near-duplicate tower angles and the bone chapel photograph were set aside.
